Metadata.title: Smart Street Light — Citizen Portal
Metadata.description: Report a faulty street light in under a minute and track the repair until it is fixed.

Common.errorBody: Please check your connection and try again.

Home.title: Street light not working? Tell us and we will fix it.
Home.subtitle: Report it in under a minute, get a complaint number, and follow every step until the light is back on.

issues.title: You can report
issues.dayBurning: Light is on during the day

one.title: Identify the pole
one.body: Enter the number painted on the pole, or pick the spot on the map.

two.title: Describe the problem
two.body: Choose what is wrong and add a photo if you can.

three.title: Track the repair
three.body: Follow every update with your complaint number and get SMS alerts.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: If you see fallen wires or a risk of electric shock, stay away from the pole and call 112 immediately.

Report.title: Report a problem
Report.description: Report a faulty street light online.

Report.poleInvalid: This number is not valid. Please check it on the plate.
Report.useLocation: I cannot find the number — use my location
Report.locationReady: Your location will be used to find the nearest pole.
Report.locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Please enter the pole number instead.
Report.descriptionHint: For example: which side of the road, a nearby landmark.
Report.phoneHint: We will send a 6-digit code by SMS. Your number is never shown publicly.
Report.successJoined: This problem was already reported. Your complaint has been added and you will get updates.
Report.successBody: Keep this number to track the repair. You will also get an SMS when it is fixed.
